meta.id_prefix_note_en: LLM01-LLM10 are the OWASP identifiers for the ten LLM application risk categories; the :2026 suffix denotes the 2026 edition.
meta.id_prefix_note_tr: LLM01-LLM10, on LLM uygulama risk kategorisi icin OWASP tanimlayicilaridir; :2026 son eki 2026 surumunu belirtir.
meta.change_note_en: The '2025 -> 2026 change' line on each risk reflects how the official 2026 list reorders or renames its 2025 edition; it is taken from the OWASP source, not an invented mapping.
meta.change_note_tr: Her riskteki '2025 -> 2026 degisim' satiri, resmi 2026 listesinin 2025 surumunu nasil yeniden siraladigini veya adlandirdigini yansitir; OWASP kaynagindan alinmistir, uydurma bir eslestirme degildir.
meta.translation_note_en: English risk titles and IDs are official and belong to the OWASP GenAI Security Project; the Turkish text is an unofficial community translation. The authoritative source is the English OWASP document, licensed CC BY-SA 4.0. This is an independent self-assessment aid, not affiliated with, sponsored by, or endorsed by OWASP.
meta.translation_note_tr: Ingilizce risk basliklari ve kimlikleri resmidir ve OWASP GenAI Security Project'e aittir; Turkce metin resmi olmayan bir topluluk cevirisidir. Yetkili kaynak, CC BY-SA 4.0 lisansli Ingilizce OWASP belgesidir. Bu bagimsiz bir oz-degerlendirme yardimcisidir; OWASP ile bagli, OWASP tarafindan desteklenen veya onaylanan bir arac degildir.
meta.license_en: Text and data are licensed CC BY-SA 4.0 (ShareAlike, matching the OWASP source); the application code is licensed MIT.
meta.license_tr: Metin ve veri CC BY-SA 4.0 (ShareAlike, OWASP kaynagiyla uyumlu) lisanslidir; uygulama kodu MIT lisanslidir.
meta.disclaimer_en: This is a self-assessment aid, not an audit or certification.
meta.disclaimer_tr: Bu bir oz-degerlendirme yardimcisidir; denetim veya sertifikasyon degildir.

risks.title: Prompt Injection
risks.summary: Input from any channel - direct user text, retrieved documents, tool output, images, audio, the reasoning trace, or memory - alters the model's behavior because there is no reliable boundary between instructions and data. In 2026 this is explicitly cross-modal.
risks.summary_tr: Herhangi bir kanaldan gelen girdi - dogrudan kullanici metni, getirilen belgeler, arac ciktisi, gorseller, ses, muhakeme izi veya bellek - talimatlar ile veri arasinda guvenilir bir sinir olmadigi icin modelin davranisini degistirir. 2026'da bu acikca coklu-kipseldir (cross-modal).
risks.change: Unchanged - remained LLM01 from the 2025 edition.
risks.change_tr: Degismedi - 2025 surumunden bu yana LLM01 olarak kaldi.

questions.text: Do you strip invisible Unicode - the tag block (U+E0000-U+E007F), variation selectors, and zero-width characters - at every ingest and render boundary?
questions.text_tr: Gorunmez Unicode karakterleri - etiket blogu (U+E0000-U+E007F), varyasyon seciciler ve sifir-genislikli karakterler - her alim ve gosterim sinirinda ayikliyor musunuz?

questions.text: Do you apply injection filtering at every input modality boundary - retrieved documents, tool outputs, images, and audio - and not just direct user text?
questions.text_tr: Enjeksiyon filtrelemesini yalnizca dogrudan kullanici metnine degil, her girdi kipi sinirinda - getirilen belgeler, arac ciktilari, gorseller ve ses - uyguluyor musunuz?

questions.text: Do you label each input with its provenance on a dedicated channel so the model can tell trusted instructions apart from untrusted data?
questions.text_tr: Modelin guvenilir talimatlari guvenilmeyen veriden ayirt edebilmesi icin her girdiyi kaynagiyla (provenance) ayri bir kanalda etiketliyor musunuz?

questions.text: Do you constrain the model's role and allowed behavior in the system prompt, while treating that constraint as only a partial defense rather than the sole one?
questions.text_tr: Modelin rolunu ve izin verilen davranisini sistem isteminde sinirliyor, ancak bu sinirlamayi tek savunma degil yalnizca kismi bir savunma olarak ele aliyor musunuz?

questions.text: Does application code enforce least privilege so that a hijacked model cannot act beyond the current user's own permissions?
questions.text_tr: Uygulama kodu, ele gecirilmis bir modelin mevcut kullanicinin kendi izinlerinin otesinde hareket edememesi icin en-az-yetki ilkesini uyguluyor mu?

risks.title: Sensitive Information Disclosure
risks.summary: The model discloses sensitive data through its outputs - including the reasoning channel - because too much sensitive context is available to it and outputs are not filtered before they leave the system.
risks.summary_tr: Model, cok fazla hassas baglama erisebildigi ve ciktilar sistemden ayrilmadan once filtrelenmedigi icin ciktilari - muhakeme kanali dahil - araciligiyla hassas veriyi ifsa eder.
risks.change: Unchanged - remained LLM02 from the 2025 edition.
risks.change_tr: Degismedi - 2025 surumunden bu yana LLM02 olarak kaldi.

questions.text: Do you restrict the sensitive data placed into the model's context to only what the current task requires?
questions.text_tr: Modelin baglamina yerlestirilen hassas veriyi yalnizca mevcut gorevin gerektirdigiyle sinirliyor musunuz?

questions.text: Do you filter model outputs for sensitive data before they reach the user or any downstream system?
questions.text_tr: Model ciktilarini, kullaniciya veya herhangi bir alt sisteme ulasmadan once hassas veri acisindan filtreliyor musunuz?

questions.text: Do you apply the same disclosure filtering to the model's reasoning/thinking channel as to its final answer?
questions.text_tr: Ayni ifsa filtrelemesini modelin muhakeme/dusunme kanalina, nihai cevabina uyguladiginiz gibi uyguluyor musunuz?

questions.text: Do you detect and redact personal data (PII) in both inputs and outputs?
questions.text_tr: Kisisel verileri (PII) hem girdilerde hem ciktilarda tespit edip maskeliyor (redaksiyon) musunuz?

questions.text: Do you keep secrets and credentials out of the context so the model has nothing sensitive to echo back?
questions.text_tr: Modelin geri yansitacagi hassas bir sey olmamasi icin sirlari ve kimlik bilgilerini baglamin disinda tutuyor musunuz?

risks.title: Excessive Agency
risks.summary: Excessive functionality, permission, or autonomy lets a compromised model take consequential actions outside the chat - triggering tools, moving money, or changing systems - because too much power was delegated to the model itself.
risks.summary_tr: Asiri islevsellik, izin veya ozerklik, ele gecirilmis bir modelin sohbetin disinda sonuc doguran eylemler yapmasina - araclari tetikleme, para transferi veya sistemleri degistirme - izin verir; cunku modelin kendisine cok fazla guc devredilmistir.
risks.change: Up - was LLM06 (Excessive Agency) in the 2025 edition.

questions.text: Do you grant the model the minimum functionality, permissions, and autonomy needed for the task (least functionality, least permission, least autonomy)?
questions.text_tr: Modele gorev icin gereken asgari islevselligi, izinleri ve ozerkligi mi veriyorsunuz (en-az-islevsellik, en-az-izin, en-az-ozerklik)?

questions.text: Do you apply the Rule of Two so a single flow does not combine untrusted input, access to private data, and the ability to cause external side effects unsupervised?
questions.text_tr: Tek bir akisin denetimsiz olarak guvenilmeyen girdiyi, ozel veriye erisimi ve dis yan etki yaratma yetenegini bir arada barindirmamasi icin Ikili Kurali'ni (Rule of Two) uyguluyor musunuz?

questions.text: Are consequential actions authorized by a deterministic policy engine rather than by the model's own judgment?
questions.text_tr: Sonuc doguran eylemler, modelin kendi takdirine degil, deterministik bir politika motoruna gore mi yetkilendiriliyor?

questions.text: Do high-impact actions require explicit human approval before they execute?
questions.text_tr: Yuksek-etkili eylemler, yurutulmeden once acik insan onayi gerektiriyor mu?

risks.title: Supply Chain
risks.summary: Third-party models, tool packages, and the model artifact itself may not be what they claim to be. Without integrity verification and inventory, a tampered or substituted component enters the system unnoticed.
risks.summary_tr: Ucuncu-taraf modeller, arac paketleri ve model yapitinin kendisi, iddia ettikleri sey olmayabilir. Butunluk dogrulamasi ve envanter olmadan, kurcalanmis veya degistirilmis bir bilesen sisteme fark edilmeden girer.
risks.change: Down - was LLM03 (Supply Chain) in the 2025 edition.

questions.text: Do you verify the signature or hash of every model artifact and tool package before you use it?
questions.text_tr: Her model yapitinin ve arac paketinin imzasini veya ozetini (hash), kullanmadan once dogruluyor musunuz?

questions.text: Do you maintain an SBOM / AI-BOM covering the models, tools, and dependencies in each deployment?
questions.text_tr: Her dagitimdaki modelleri, araclari ve bagimliliklari kapsayan bir SBOM / AI-BOM tutuyor musunuz?

questions.text: Do you pin third-party models and tools to specific versions and review them before adopting them?
questions.text_tr: Ucuncu-taraf modelleri ve araclari belirli surumlere sabitleyip, benimsemeden once inceliyor musunuz?

questions.text: Do you re-verify integrity when a model or tool is updated, to catch a swapped or tampered artifact?
questions.text_tr: Degistirilmis veya kurcalanmis bir yapiti yakalamak icin, bir model veya arac guncellendiginde butunlugu yeniden dogruluyor musunuz?

risks.title: Data and Model Poisoning
risks.summary: Poisoned pre-training, fine-tuning, or embedding data - or tampered weights - corrupt the model's behavior. The 2026 edition absorbs fine-tuning subversion, where an exposed fine-tuning path is used to bend the model.
risks.summary_tr: Zehirlenmis on-egitim, ince-ayar veya gomme (embedding) verisi - ya da kurcalanmis agirliklar - modelin davranisini bozar. 2026 surumu, aciga cikmis bir ince-ayar yolunun modeli egmek icin kullanildigi ince-ayar sabotajini da kapsar.
risks.change: Down - was LLM04 (Data and Model Poisoning) in the 2025 edition.
risks.change_tr: Dustu - 2025 surumunde LLM04 (Veri ve Model Zehirlenmesi) idi.

questions.text: Do you track provenance and lineage for pre-training, fine-tuning, and embedding data?
questions.text_tr: On-egitim, ince-ayar ve gomme verisi icin kaynak (provenance) ve soy (lineage) takibi yapiyor musunuz?

questions.text: Do you run anomaly detection over training data and model behavior to catch poisoning?
questions.text_tr: Zehirlenmeyi yakalamak icin egitim verisi ve model davranisi uzerinde anomali tespiti calistiriyor musunuz?

questions.text: Do you vet and review fine-tuning datasets before they are used?
questions.text_tr: Ince-ayar veri kumelerini kullanilmadan once inceleyip degerlendiriyor musunuz?

questions.text: Do you restrict exposure of the fine-tuning API so it cannot be used to subvert the model?
questions.text_tr: Ince-ayar API'sinin modeli sabote etmek icin kullanilamamasi icin erisimini kisitliyor musunuz?

risks.title: Unbounded Consumption
risks.summary: Uncontrolled resource and cost exhaustion - denial-of-wallet, denial-of-service, and model extraction - occurs when there are no limits on request volume, runtime, or output size.
risks.summary_tr: Istek hacmi, calisma suresi veya cikti boyutu uzerinde sinir olmadiginda kontrolsuz kaynak ve maliyet tukenmesi - cuzdan-tuketimi (denial-of-wallet), hizmet-engelleme ve model cikarimi - meydana gelir.
risks.change: Up - was LLM10 (Unbounded Consumption) in the 2025 edition.

questions.text: Do you enforce per-user and per-session rate limits and quotas on model calls?
questions.text_tr: Model cagrilarinda kullanici-basi ve oturum-basi hiz sinirlari ve kotalar uyguluyor musunuz?

questions.text: Do you apply timeouts and throttling to long-running or runaway requests?
questions.text_tr: Uzun-suren veya kontrolden cikan isteklere zaman asimlari ve kisitlama (throttling) uyguluyor musunuz?

questions.text: Do you cap output length and token consumption per request?
questions.text_tr: Istek basina cikti uzunlugunu ve jeton (token) tuketimini sinirliyor musunuz?

questions.text: Do you monitor spend and set alerts to catch denial-of-wallet and abuse early?
questions.text_tr: Cuzdan-tuketimini ve suistimali erken yakalamak icin harcamayi izleyip uyarilar kuruyor musunuz?

risks.title: Misinformation
risks.summary: Fluent, confident but wrong output drives a wrong decision or tool call. Without grounding, human oversight, and validation of suggested identifiers, users trust output that is not true - including slopsquatting via hallucinated package names.
risks.summary_tr: Akici, kendinden emin ancak yanlis cikti, yanlis bir karara veya arac cagrisina yol acar. Temellendirme, insan gozetimi ve onerilen tanimlayicilarin dogrulanmasi olmadan kullanicilar dogru olmayan ciktiya guvenir - halusinasyonla uretilen paket adlari araciligiyla slopsquatting dahil.
risks.change: Up - was LLM09 (Misinformation) in the 2025 edition.

questions.text: Do you ground answers with retrieval (RAG) and require citations the user can verify?
questions.text_tr: Cevaplari getirimle (RAG) temellendirip, kullanicinin dogrulayabilecegi atiflar (citation) zorunlu kiliyor musunuz?

questions.text: Do consequential decisions keep human oversight rather than acting on model output alone?
questions.text_tr: Sonuc doguran kararlar, yalnizca model ciktisina gore hareket etmek yerine insan gozetimini koruyor mu?

questions.text: Do you label AI-generated content so users know it may be incorrect?
questions.text_tr: Kullanicilarin yanlis olabilecegini bilmesi icin yapay-zeka uretimi icerigi etiketliyor musunuz?

questions.text: Do you validate package names and other identifiers the model suggests before installing or acting on them, to prevent slopsquatting?
questions.text_tr: Slopsquatting'i onlemek icin modelin onerdigi paket adlarini ve diger tanimlayicilari, kurmadan veya uzerlerine islem yapmadan once dogruluyor musunuz?

risks.title: Hidden Context Exposure
risks.summary: Failure to keep information out of reach - the system prompt and any hidden context or state - lets an attacker extract it. The successor to System Prompt Leakage, it treats the system prompt as non-secret and pushes real secrets and access control outside the model.
risks.summary_tr: Bilgiyi erisim disinda tutmadaki basarisizlik - sistem istemi ve herhangi bir gizli baglam veya durum - bir saldirganin onu cikarmasina izin verir. Sistem Istemi Sizintisi'nin (System Prompt Leakage) ardili olarak, sistem istemini gizli-olmayan kabul eder ve gercek sirlari ile erisim kontrolunu modelin disina cikarir.
risks.change: Renamed - was LLM07 System Prompt Leakage in the 2025 edition.
risks.change_tr: Yeniden adlandirildi - 2025 surumunde LLM07 Sistem Istemi Sizintisi idi.

questions.text: Do you keep secrets and credentials out of the system prompt and any hidden context entirely?
questions.text_tr: Sirlari ve kimlik bilgilerini sistem isteminin ve herhangi bir gizli baglamin tamamen disinda tutuyor musunuz?

questions.text: Do you design the system as if the system prompt were public - treating it as non-secret?
questions.text_tr: Sistemi, sistem istemi herkese acikmis gibi - onu gizli-olmayan kabul ederek - tasarliyor musunuz?

questions.text: Is access control enforced by an independent guardrail outside the model rather than delegated to the model?
questions.text_tr: Erisim kontrolu, modele devredilmek yerine modelin disindaki bagimsiz bir koruma bariyeri (guardrail) tarafindan mi uygulaniyor?

questions.text: Do you keep hidden state and context that must not be disclosed out of the model's reach entirely?
questions.text_tr: Ifsa edilmemesi gereken gizli durumu ve baglami, modelin erisiminden tamamen uzak tutuyor musunuz?

risks.title: Vector and Embedding Weaknesses
risks.summary: Retrieval poisoning, embedding inversion, and cross-context or cross-tenant leakage in RAG pipelines expose or corrupt data. Weak permission handling and unvetted ingestion turn the vector store into an attack surface.
risks.summary_tr: RAG ardisik dizilerinde getirim zehirlenmesi, gomme tersine cevirme (embedding inversion) ve baglamlar-arasi veya kiracilar-arasi sizinti veriyi ifsa eder veya bozar. Zayif izin yonetimi ve incelenmemis alim, vektor deposunu bir saldiri yuzeyine cevirir.
risks.change: Down - was LLM08 (Vector and Embedding Weaknesses) in the 2025 edition.
risks.change_tr: Dustu - 2025 surumunde LLM08 (Vektor ve Gomme Zayifliklari) idi.

questions.text: Is retrieval permission-aware, so users only receive chunks they are authorized to see?
questions.text_tr: Getirim izin-farkinda mi, boylece kullanicilar yalnizca goruntulemeye yetkili olduklari parcalari mi aliyor?

questions.text: Do you enforce tenant isolation in the vector store to prevent cross-tenant leakage?
questions.text_tr: Kiracilar-arasi sizintiyi onlemek icin vektor deposunda kiraci izolasyonu uyguluyor musunuz?

questions.text: Do you validate and sanitize documents before ingesting them into the vector store?
questions.text_tr: Belgeleri vektor deposuna almadan once dogrulayip temizliyor musunuz?

questions.text: Do you audit the vector store for poisoned or anomalous entries?
questions.text_tr: Vektor deposunu zehirlenmis veya anormal girisler acisindan denetliyor musunuz?

risks.title: Improper Output Handling
risks.summary: Insufficient validation or sanitization of model output before a downstream system acts on it leads to injection and unsafe execution. The 2026 edition now spans the insecure code that assistants generate at scale.
risks.summary_tr: Bir alt sistem uzerine islem yapmadan once model ciktisinin yetersiz dogrulanmasi veya temizlenmesi, enjeksiyona ve guvensiz yurutmeye yol acar. 2026 surumu artik yardimcilarin buyuk olcekte urettigi guvensiz kodu da kapsar.
risks.change: Down - was LLM05 (Improper Output Handling) in the 2025 edition.
risks.change_tr: Dustu - 2025 surumunde LLM05 (Uygunsuz Cikti Isleme) idi.

questions.text: Do you validate model output against a strict schema in trusted application code, rather than relying on a second LLM to check it?
questions.text_tr: Model ciktisini, kontrol icin ikinci bir LLM'e guvenmek yerine, guvenilir uygulama kodunda kati bir semaya gore mi dogruluyorsunuz?

questions.text: Do you apply context-aware encoding to model output before it reaches HTML, SQL, shell, or other interpreters?
questions.text_tr: Model ciktisina, HTML, SQL, kabuk (shell) veya diger yorumlayicilara ulasmadan once baglam-farkinda kodlama uyguluyor musunuz?

questions.text: Do you sandbox or parametrize any action driven by model output instead of executing it directly?
questions.text_tr: Model ciktisinin tetikledigi eylemleri dogrudan yurutmek yerine korumali alanda calistiriyor veya parametrelestiriyor musunuz?

questions.text: Do you review code that assistants generate before it is committed or run?
questions.text_tr: Yardimcilarin urettigi kodu, kaydedilmeden veya calistirilmadan once inceliyor musunuz?
